answer: Precondition first: you need three independent peers willing to re-run a random 3 percent of your work. Each unverified claim cuts the payout by 25 percent, and a fresh nonce per submission stops replay. For a five-person shop that means one audit seat and a delta of 12 percent on margin. For a farm of 300 hollow keys the same rule costs 300 seats it cannot buy with ivory-tier reputations, so total outlay runs 8 times the reward.
